Serena (VP Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — people asked for clearer timelines on the API, Console, and Optimize work. I'll sketch what we intend and tag owners. Please correct or add specifics.

Dana (Product): High level: API streaming + reliability improvements, Console per-route dashboards + export, Optimize auto-batching recommender. Target windows below (tentative):
- API streaming perf alpha: mid-July (internal), public beta: late-August, GA: late-Oct.
- Console per-route dashboards: beta in early-September, GA end of Q4.
- Optimize auto-batching & quantization suggestions: beta early-October, GA next quarter.

Ethan (Eng): Quick technical note: API streaming perf needs a new kernel selector + batching tweaks. Alpha will be internal perf runs + smoke tests. We can't hit beta without the KV-cache changes landing first.

Priya (Engineering PM): Rollout plan: 10% canary for hosted API (two-week observation), expand to 50% if no regressions, then GA. Console features will be behind an access flag for customers; we'll invite partners for the beta.

Jorge (Solutions): For partners doing early Console beta, can we get migration guides and example dashboards? Customers will want templates (billing, latency, per-model).

Dana (Product): Yes — Jorge is on point. We'll publish a migration + dashboard templates repo during beta. Link will go into the beta invite.

Ethan (Eng): Ops note: canary rollout command we'll use for Dedicated/Private is: ```redwoodctl rollout canary --service=api --pct=10 --duration=14d``` Please don't run that locally unless you're oncall :grimacing:.

ops-bot: deploy status: api-kernel-rollout started for internal alpha at 1757777900 :package: (logs available in #eng-runtime)

Priya (Engineering PM): Owner matrix: Dana (product lead), Ethan (eng lead), Jorge (solutions/beta partner), Priya (release coordination). I'll add timeline milestones to the product board and share a short weekly sync invite for owners.

Jorge (Solutions): Can we get a short FAQ for customers about expected latency changes and rollback behavior? Sales will ask.

Dana (Product): Good call. We'll write an FAQ: what to expect, SLOs, how to opt out, and rollback steps. Draft by next Wed.

Serena (VP Product): Thanks — this is exactly what folks wanted. If anyone needs items surfaced in the next leadership sync, reply here or DM me. :thumbsup:
